law_name: Law on Legal Protection of Personal Data (Law No. XIII-1426)
key_requirements: Applies with GDPR, powers of supervisory authorities, fining procedure
enforcement_authority: State Data Protection Inspectorate (Valstybinė duomenų apsaugos inspekcija)
deceased_data: No specific rules in the data protection law (pre-2018 text excluded deceased persons); privacy of the deceased protected by the Civil Code (consent of spouse, children or parents)
research_exemption: Relies on GDPR art. 89 safeguards and derogations for archiving, research and statistics; national derogation article not confirmed (unconfirmed)
genetic_data: Special category under art. 9 GDPR; no specific national rule found in the Law (unconfirmed)
notes: Replaced the 1996 law I-1374; separate Law XIII-1435 covers criminal-justice data
